description: This file defines the AttendanceConfigurationModel class, which implements the Normalizable interface to serialize attendance configuration data into an array. It acts as an API presentation layer for the AttendanceConfiguration data transfer object within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationModel
classes.description: Represents a serializable model for attendance configuration settings used in the API layer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an AttendanceConfiguration object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the attendance configuration into an associative array suitable for API responses.
